changed: Every button, switch and checkbox now dims while pressed, so a tap on a phone is answered even where there is no hover.
Headings break into even lines, and paragraphs no longer leave a single word on their last line.
On a desktop, scrolling past the top or bottom of a page no longer bounces the top bar away from the edge.
fixed: Scrolling with a dialog open no longer moves the list behind it, and the page no longer shifts sideways when one opens.
